title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang is 'playing both sides' of AI with Hugging Face purchase
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) is buying AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion in a move that could extend Nvidia's reach in the AI ecosystem beyond being just a chip supplier. Futurum CEO Daniel Newman reacts to this headline news and what the acquisition of Hugging Face represents for Nvidia's growing market share of the AI landscape.

summary: Supply is secured for two straight doublings, the CEO says. Deployment is the part no chipmaker can promise.

title: Nvidia Is Now Paying to Train Plumbers, and the Stock That Should Benefit Most Just Hit a 52-Week Low
summary: Nvidia just committed serious money to train plumbers and electricians, and the retailer that sells to those exact tradespeople responded by printing a 52-week low. Something in that equation does not add up.

title: AI Infrastructure Demand Remains Red-Hot: HPE, AVGO, DELL Deliver
summary: The AI trade remains alive and well, with Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), Broadcom (AVGO), and Dell Technologies (DELL) all recently posting strong quarterly results.

summary: Third-quarter revenue hit $29.59 billion as AI-semiconductor sales reached $16.7 billion.

title: Should You Buy Marvell Stock Because Its Operating Margin Keeps Widening?
summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) lifted its revenue outlook for fiscal 2027 and fiscal 2028 in its late-August report. The stock, at about $206, is up more than 220% over the past twelve months and down about 32% over the past three months. The bear case is the gross margin, and management supplied the number. The counter sits one line further down, in an operating margin that has widened two years running.

title: Stocks to Watch Thursday Recap: Snowflake, Broadcom, HPE, Ultragenyx
summary: ↗️ Snowflake (SNOW): The cloud-storage company reported a narrower quarterly loss, saying AI drove its business. Its stock surged nearly 17% ↘️ Broadcom (AVGO): The company was bullish about demand for its custom chips over the next two years; shares slipped 2.

title: Do You Still Own The NVIDIA You Bought?
summary: NVIDIA (NVDA) has been an easy stock to hold. The shares trade near $224, up about 32% over the past year and comfortably ahead of the S&P 500. The tape has not changed. What changed is how management describes the company, and the description it dropped is the one most holders bought into.

title: Why Broadcom (AVGO) Stock Is Nosediving
summary: Shares of fabless chip and software maker Broadcom (NASDAQ:AVGO) fell 5.8% in the morning session after the company reported second-quarter 2026 financial results that failed to impress as its sales outlook for the next quarter fell below Wall Street’s expectations.
